activity.notes: Dae Joyeong founded Balhae in 698 and reigned as its first king until 719. ATLAS records the sovereign reign as the representative Activity.

sources.title: 고왕
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Dae Joyeong as Balhae's first king and gives his reign as 698–719.

sources.title: 발해
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that Dae Joyeong founded Balhae in 698.
